chunks: And Rifā‘ah narrated from him that he said:
Regarding a man who does not know whether he performed six or seven rounds of tawaf, he said: “He should build upon what he is certain of.”

key_terms.رِفَاعَةُ: Rifā‘ah, the narrator transmitting this report
key_terms.يَبْنِي: he bases or builds his action upon
key_terms.يَقِينِهِ: his certainty; what is definitely established

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if he doubts whether he performed six or seven rounds of tawaf?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for uncertainty in the number of rounds of tawaf. When a person doubts between six and seven, he is to act according to certainty and base his action on what is definitely known.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.2804 - It is narrated from Rifa‘ah that Imam (as) said regarding a man who does not know whether he performed six or seven rounds of tawaf:
"He should act based on what he is certain of."
